item.title: Palo Alto students lead walkout to show support for immigrants
item.description: Hundreds of Palo Alto students came out to protest ICE and show support for immigrants during a Tuesday afternoon walk-out that included all three middle schools in the Palo Alto Unified School District as well as dozens of Gunn High School students.
